    override fun visitElement(context: XmlContext, element: Element) {

                        when (childElement.tagName) {

                }
            }

            if (node.nodeType == Node.ELEMENT_NODE && node.nodeName == TAG_INTENT_FILTER) {

                                    hasCategory = true
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (hasAction && hasCategory) return true
            }
        }
        return false
    }
